purpose: Teach: 組曲/のぞき/刺客/転居/つぐ/導か/病理/全土

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組曲、つまり連続演奏会場周辺の事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: The police will be investigating this case thoroughly, especially around the concert venue area, won't they?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful tone. Slight upward lilt at the end—posing it as a shared observation rather than a question. Deliberate pacing. Calm conviction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、のぞき行為の取り締まりを、警察、強化されますね
lines.en: Yes, the department is strengthening enforcement against voyeurism in the area.
lines.style: Professional but warm. Nods slightly with the opening. Direct, matter-of-fact delivery. Steady eye contact. Reassuring without being dismissive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、政治家を狙った刺客の警戒を、警察、強められますね
lines.en: And the police will be increasing security measures for politicians in this district, I imagine?
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Slight pause before 'security'—gathering the next thought. Steady breath. The tone of someone working through a logical chain aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の転居先を、警察、突き止められますね
lines.en: We've been able to locate the suspect's new address, yes.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Slight pride in the competence. Not boastful—just stating fact. Brief, confident delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、加害者が後をつぐ、つまり継ぐ事の防止を、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: So the police will also be working to prevent the perpetrator from continuing this pattern, correct?
lines.style: Quiet, serious. The words come slowly—he's checking his own understanding as he speaks. Slight furrow in the delivery. Respectful of the gravity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、結論に導かれる証拠を、警察、慎重に集められますね
lines.en: We're gathering evidence carefully to ensure we reach the right conclusion.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. Emphasise 'carefully'—a slight weight on that word. Slow pace. The reassurance of someone who won't rush the investigation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の病理解剖を、警察、医師と連携されますね
lines.en: We'll be coordinating with the medical examiner regarding the victim's autopsy.
lines.style: Respectful, quiet solemnity. Slower tempo. Clinical but not cold—there's care in the precision. Slight pause before 'autopsy'.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、全土の警察組織で連携した広域捜査もされますね
lines.en: Yes, we're conducting a wide-area investigation with police departments across the region.
lines.style: Firmer, more present. A closing statement—finality in the tone. Direct eye contact. The confidence of a coordinated effort.
